terms.title: Terms of Service and Enterprise License

nature.title: 1. Nature of Service and Regulatory Framework
nature.content: Nirium is a technology infrastructure platform (IaaS) designed under the 'Novel Models' standards in accordance with Article 80 of the Law to Regulate Financial Technology Institutions (Mexico). Nirium operates strictly as a software provider facilitating treasury automation and not as a Financial Technology Institution (ITF) or banking entity. The platform provides an immutable forensic audit trail (Protocol Archive) and Soroban security protocols for experimentation with digital assets in controlled environments. Custody, settlement, and issuance services for Global Bonds (RWA) are the exclusive responsibility of regulated third-party providers (Etherfuse/Indeval) under their own licenses and terms.

no_guarantees.title: 2. No Guarantees — Not an Investment Product
no_guarantees.content:
Nirium does not guarantee returns of any kind. The ELO reputation system is strictly informational and reflects historical algorithmic performance on Stellar Testnet — it does not constitute a promise of future gain.

Nirium is not an investment product, security, fund, or financial instrument. Capital remains under the sovereign control of the user's private keys at all times. Nirium is a technology infrastructure protocol that users interact with at their own risk.

ai_liability.title: 3. Autonomous Agent & AI Liability
ai_liability.content: By activating the agent 'Execution Cluster' or 'Loop', the user grants a limited technical mandate for the code (LLM/Agent) to build and propose transactions based on pre-configured parameters. The user acknowledges that Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama) may exhibit 'algorithmic hallucinations', data biases, or critical latency. Nirium acts as a transmission interface and assumes no responsibility for autonomous decisions made by the AI kernel or for systemic failures in decentralized price oracles or the public Stellar network.

rwa_disclaimer.title: 4. Real World Asset (RWA) Risks
rwa_disclaimer.content: Operations with Global Bonds and other real-world assets (RWA) are subject to availability, banking window constraints, and regulations of the Mexican financial system. Nirium acts solely as a technological bridge (Middleware). Counterparty risk, underlying asset custody, and liquidity rest entirely with the bond issuer and the final custodian (Indeval). Tokenization of these assets on Stellar Testnet is representative and experimental.

dispute.title: 5. Jurisdiction and Cryptographic Arbitration
dispute.content: Any controversy shall be resolved through binding arbitration under the rules of the Mexico City Chamber of Commerce. By connecting your wallet, the user expressly waives class-action lawsuits. These terms are governed by the federal laws of the United Mexican States.

infrastructure.title: 6. Infrastructure and Availability (SaaS/IaaS)
infrastructure.content: Nirium provides infrastructure services on an 'as is' basis under the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model. As final execution depends on the public Stellar network, third-party LLM providers, and data oracles, Nirium does not guarantee 100% availability. The platform implements security protocols inspired by ISO 27001 for the data layer, but is not liable for losses resulting from blockchain congestion, network forks, or outages of third-party cloud services.

reverse_solicitation.title: 7. Reverse Solicitation and International Compliance
reverse_solicitation.content: Nirium does not make a public offering of securities or financial services in jurisdictions where it is not registered. User access from restricted jurisdictions is considered a proactive, private, and individual request ('Reverse Solicitation'). The user declares they have not been induced by targeted marketing and is solely responsible for complying with the laws of their country of residence.

intellectual_property.title: 8. Algorithmic Intellectual Property
intellectual_property.content: All algorithms, agent logic ('Execution Cluster'), network architectures, and proprietary visualizations are the exclusive intellectual property of Nirium. Use of the platform grants a limited, non-exclusive, and revocable license. Use of the interface does not grant ownership, modification, or reverse engineering rights to the core artificial intelligence engine.

stellar_code.title: 9. Alignment with Stellar Code of Conduct and SCF 7.0
stellar_code.content: Nirium strictly adheres to the principles of the Stellar Development Foundation (SDF) and the Stellar Community Fund (SCF) version 7.0 guidelines (Updated April 30, 2026), promoting an ecosystem of open innovation, mutual respect, and technical transparency. Users, node operators, and developers commit to interacting under professional standards, following the official Stellar Code of Conduct and prohibiting any malicious behavior that compromises the integrity of the network.

execution.title: 1. Autonomous Execution Risks
execution.content: By delegating vault operations to AI agents or community-published strategy logic, you are authorizing code to execute autonomous financial transactions on the Stellar network. While the Soroban smart contracts utilize atomic, single-invocation wrappers ('Panic on loss' protection), systemic failures, oracle manipulation, or extreme lack of liquidity can result in total loss of funds.

governance.title: 3. Ecosystem Governance & SCF 7.0 Alignment
governance.content: Nirium operates within the Stellar Community Fund (SCF 7.0) framework and adheres to the Stellar Code of Conduct. While we strive for the highest standards of transparency, our project is experimental and milestone-based. Users are expected to participate in the community with professional integrity and follow the official guidelines updated as of April 30, 2026.

risk_disclosure.footer: By connecting your wallet, you accept all risks outlined above.

sovereignty.title: 1. Non-Custodial Architecture
sovereignty.content: Nirium is a non-custodial interface. We never collect, store, or transmit your private keys or recovery phrases. All transaction signing occurs locally within your authorized wallet provider (e.g., Freighter). You are the sole custodian of your assets.

anonymity.title: 2. On-Chain Transparency
anonymity.content: As a protocol built on Stellar, all transactions and vault operations are public and immutable. Nirium does not link your public keys to your real-world identity unless explicitly required for specific institutional compliance modules (KYC/KYB) which are handled by authorized third-party providers.

institutional.title: 4. Institutional Compliance & SCF Transparency
institutional.content: In accordance with SCF 7.0 transparency guidelines, Nirium maintains an open-source technical architecture. We prioritize data sovereignty and institutional-grade privacy protocols, ensuring that your financial operations remain confidential while adhering to global compliance standards updated as of April 30, 2026.

telemetry.title: 3. Minimal Telemetry
telemetry.content: We collect technical telemetry (browser version, network latency, execution logs) strictly for protocol maintenance and security monitoring. We do not sell user data or use third-party marketing trackers.

disclaimers.title: Legal Disclaimers & Risk Warnings

general.title: 1. General Risk Disclaimer
general.content:
Nirium Protocol is experimental, unaudited software currently deployed exclusively on the Stellar Testnet. All interactions involve test tokens with NO monetary value. Nirium does not manage, control, or custody real financial assets at this stage.

Past performance of any algorithm, strategy, or agent — including ELO scores and simulated metrics — does NOT guarantee or imply future results. Volatility is inherent to DeFi protocols, and users should expect the possibility of total loss.

no_advice.title: 2. Not Financial Advice
no_advice.content: Nothing on this website, documentation, or communication from Nirium constitutes financial, investment, or trading advice. You should consult with a qualified professional advisor before making any decisions. The Nirium team are not registered financial advisors or broker-dealers.

smart_contract.title: 3. Smart Contract Risk
smart_contract.content: Soroban smart contracts (Vault, ELO Registry, etc.) have NOT been formally audited. They may contain bugs or vulnerabilities resulting in loss of funds. Nirium provides these contracts 'as-is' without warranties of any kind.

ai_agent.title: 4. AI Agent Execution Risk
ai_agent.content: Nirium utilizes autonomous AI agents (LLMs). These systems are inherently unpredictable and may exhibit 'hallucinations' or make suboptimal economic decisions. By activating any agent, you accept full responsibility for the outcomes.

testnet.title: 5. Testnet vs. Mainnet Distinction
testnet.content: Nirium operates exclusively on Stellar Testnet. Tokens have no real value, the network may reset, and all performance metrics are technological validation simulations.

no_warranty.title: 6. No Warranty (AS-IS Software)
no_warranty.content: THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED 'AS IS', WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND. Authors shall not be liable for any claim, damages, or other liability arising from the use of the software.

hero.subtitle: An AI agent on Stellar that rebalances your treasury between USDC and CETES via Etherfuse 24/7. No CFO. No spreadsheets. No WhatsApp.

step1.title: 24/7 Autonomous Monitoring
step1.body: Continuously monitors current benchmark rates (Blend USDC and Etherfuse CETES) via real-time Soroban oracles. No manual polling.

step2.title: Applies your policy
step2.body: You define: spread threshold (1.5%), USDC minimum liquidity (0K), max bond exposure (60%). The agent respects these rules.

step3.title: Decides to rebalance
step3.body: If Bond vs USDC spread exceeds your threshold, executes. Otherwise holds. Every decision is signed and traceable.

step4.title: Executes on Stellar (~4s)
step4.body: Via pathPaymentStrictReceive on SDEX or direct Etherfuse swap. Non-custodial. Keys always remain with the client.

step5.title: Audit Persistence
step5.body: Generates a signed HMAC-SHA256 audit log, anchors it to IPFS, and updates the CNBV-exportable registry. The agent maintains 24/7 uptime.

cross_border.title: Cross-border as output
cross_border.subtitle: When the agent rebalances, cross-border payments are a natural consequence — not a separate product.
cross_border.explanation: The Fiat ↔ CETES ↔ USDC corridor via Etherfuse bypasses the expensive XLM/USDC SDEX spread (~0.8%) and replaces it with a flat 0.2% all-in fee (Etherfuse total).
